title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.174.0
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: Multiple SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go) had small but divergent implementations for auth hooks, retry/backoff policies, and streaming ergonomics. This caused customer confusion (different default timeouts/behaviors) and blocked parity in client examples and docs. Summary: This PR unifies auth provider interfaces, centralizes retry/backoff logic with a shared deterministic jitter algorithm, and brings streaming API ergonomics and cancellation parity across Python/TS/Go SDKs. It also bumps SDK package versions to v1.174.0 and updates quickstart examples and docs. What changed (high level commits): - 1) common: introduce sdk-common/auth/provider interface and sdk-common/retry strategy (exponential+full-jitter, deterministic seed per request id) (commit: common/centralize-auth-retries) - 2) python: refactor RedwoodClient to accept AuthProvider; add StreamingEventIterator, cancel() on streams, default timeout harmonized to 30s (commit: python/streaming-parity) - 3) typescript: client constructor ergonomics, async iterator streaming parity, unified backoff wrapper for fetch/ws transports (commit: ts/streaming-and-retries) - 4) go: add Context-based cancellation for streaming, pluggable AuthProvider, retry middleware for HTTP/gRPC (commit: go/auth-retries-middleware) - 5) docs/examples: update quickstarts, examples repo cross-link, update CHANGELOG and version bumps (commit: docs/sdk-quickstart-update) Files changed (high level): - sdk/common/auth/provider.go, sdk/common/retries.go - sdk/python/redwood/__init__.py, sdk/python/redwood/client.py, sdk/python/redwood/streaming.py, setup.cfg (version bump) - sdk/typescript/src/client.ts, sdk/typescript/src/streaming.ts, package.json (version bump), README.md examples - sdk/go/client.go, sdk/go/streaming.go, go.mod (version bump) - docs/sdk/quickstart.md, examples/streaming-cancelation/* Tests and CI: Unit test coverage added for retry edge cases and stream cancellation in all three SDKs. CI run: unit (python/ts/go) -> pass, lint -> fail (TS lint rule tightened), fix -> pass, e2e streaming smoke tests -> one flaky failure on internal websocket test; re-run passed. Final CI status: pass. Review conversation (summary): - @Samir Patel (review): asked for clearer backoff defaults and an option to opt-out of deterministic jitter for reproducibility in testing. - @Elena Morales (review): requested stronger typing on TS client constructor and a small API rename to keep parity with Python (suggested `stream()` -> `stream_events()`). - @Ava Chen (author): replied with design note and implemented optional jitter seed override (linked in docs), kept `stream()` but added explicit alias `stream_events()` to preserve ergonomics for existing users. - @Mohan Iyer (approval): ran performance canary on Dedicated and confirmed negligible latency regression from shared retry wrapper. Approvals: 3 reviewers approved after the changes. Merge: squash and merge via GitHub UI. Related tickets: ENG-2891, ENG-3372, PM-412. Notes for QA/Release: Coordinate SDK package published artifacts in the release pipeline: python v1.174.0, @redwood/sdk v1.174.0, go module v1.174.0. Notify SDK-consumers Slack channel about the optional jitter-seed flag and streaming alias to reduce surprise.
ci_checks: publish-checks: pending at merge time but executed in release pipeline
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth provider and retry/backoff strategy; streaming API ergonomic parity and cancellation; version bumps to v1.174.0 for Python/TypeScript/Go. Optional deterministic jitter seed added for test reproducibility.
